title: Base UnconnectedSend variant 2
purpose: Use a deeper nested explicit-message form with conservative timeout fields and an embedded service request to reach additional parser logic.

messages.label: SendRRData UnconnectedSend request with nested explicit payload

expected_behavior: The request should be framed as an unconnected explicit send carrying an inner GetAttributeSingle-style payload. A target may parse nested content, reject at service level, or return an encapsulation/CIP error while maintaining synchronization.
constraints_preserved: exactly one sequence for the supplied plan_id
little-endian payload length matches payload bytes
nested inner explicit payload kept short and internally consistent
issue_safety_notes: Only model-prior plausibility is assumed. The nested payload is intentionally compact to preserve safe, mutation-friendly structure without relying on externally verified OpENer specifics.
